biography.summary: Fatima Al-Mansoor is a fictional NeverBeen digital model and imagined creative professional in an alternate universe. In this version of her story, the city she calls home is Doha, Qatar; the neighbourhood and every biographical detail below are invented for this fictional character. After earning a fictional Bachelor of Design in Spatial Practice and going on to complete a fictional Master of Architecture in Adaptive Spaces, she spent her early career in architecture and spatial design with Open Courtyard Workshop and later Civic Form Studio, building experience in spatial composition, model-making, human-centred design. Today she works as an independent model and creative collaborator in the NeverBeen Multiverse, bringing her creative training into editorial, fashion and travel-led stories. Fatima's passions in this fictional timeline include public libraries and climate-conscious design, among other personal causes, and she enjoys street sketching, independent cinema, learning new languages in her time away from sets and studios. Her ambitions in this imagined storyline are to build a thoughtful creative label for emerging artists, to help make fashion and image-making more responsible without losing a sense of play, and to leave every collaboration more generous than she found it. The relationship status recorded for her in this chapter is "married"; the people, places and milestones below are entirely invented and exist only in the NeverBeen Multiverse.
earlyLife: In this alternate-universe story, Fatima Al-Mansoor was born on 12 April 1999 at 15:10 Asia/Qatar at the fictional NeverBeen House of Birth in The Pearl district, Doha, Qatar. The venue, date, time and every childhood episode are invented; no real address or medical record is represented.

At age four, around 2003, a slow family breakfast and the familiar rooms of home became the first small landmarks in her imagined life. The accompanying mobile-camera scene is a fictional memory, not an archival photograph.

By age eight, around 2007, she had begun exploring the nearby streets with her fictional mother Rania Al-Mansoor, noticing rain-dark pavement, shop shutters and changing light. That curiosity gradually became a habit of observation.

In secondary school, around age sixteen in 2015, she found confidence in friends and hands-on class projects. These school scenes are fictional snapshots from the character’s timeline, not records of a real school or child.

ambitions: Build a thoughtful creative label that gives emerging artists their first serious commission.
Make fashion and image-making more responsible without losing the sense of play.

finalNotes: Fatima does not treat a single label as a life sentence: designer, collaborator, model and curious traveller can all be true in the same frame.
Her version of fearlessness is not having no doubts; it is moving forward without letting doubt write the whole story.
Every school, employer, qualification, relationship, quote, memory and biographical detail on this page is fictional and exists only in the NeverBeen Multiverse.
